note: Footage library for render2.py. 'ai': true = AI-generated (George's OpenArt/Veo/other generations); false = his real app screen recordings/screenshots. Excluded on purpose: a TV showing a third-party show in his room recording, burnt-in promo text, generator watermarks (Veo mark cropped off), and AI clips in the cyan/neon or blue-UI style he rejected.

style: Dark navy + amber/orange + cream. Text: Inter Display Bold, cream lines, last line amber, top scrim. Hook on screen from frame 0.
app_reference: What the real echoes app looks like (from George's own screenshots/recordings, Nov 2026) — AI clips must not contradict it: dark navy map with gold coin-like echo markers with play icons and white dots, the user's avatar in a pin; round dark buttons with amber icons (search, friends, bell, settings) and a 'Sensing… 100–150m · N echoes' pill at top; a big orange record button with a white waveform at the bottom, AR button bottom-left, profile bottom-right, 'TAP TO ECHO'. AR mode: golden oval Reflection portals, golden rings on the floor with avatars, orange spheres, 'AURAL SPACE ACTIVE', 'TAP TO FILM A REFLECTION'. Voice card: orange waveform, amber play button, visibility tag (e.g. Private). Brand: lowercase 'echoes' wordmark in cream (also an 'Echoes' logo with a pin as the o), amber/orange on navy. Never cyan/neon or blue waveforms.
ai_label_rule: If any shot of a post uses an asset with ai=true (end cards alone don't count), schedule its Instagram post with instagramData.isAiGenerated=true and its TikTok post with tiktokData.isAigc=true. Facebook has no field for it in Metricool.
